name: Ortur Aufero AL1
tagline: Compact portable Ortur — desk-friendly engraver for small gifts
tldr: The Aufero AL1 is Ortur's compact diode line for small work areas and portable setups. Lower power than LM3 or H10, but easier to fit on a crowded desk. Best for light engraving — not a cutting workhorse.
mainObjective: Small-footprint Ortur for gift engraving & learning on a budget

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cons: Small work area limits project size
Not competitive vs LM3 for value long-term
beginnerNotes: Good if you only engrave small items like keychains and tags. If you might outgrow it within months, save for Ortur LM3 instead.
proTips: Use smaller benchmark jobs (5×5 cm) for photos on AL1 — 10×10 cm fills take noticeably longer at 5W.
primaryUse: Compact entry Ortur for small gift engraving and learning laser basics.
